findings.requirement: Task 3 / Decision 3 — error handling completeness for MESSAGE branch
findings.detail: Task 3 description and Decision 3 specify that TelegramSendException is mapped via fromTerminalReason (cancel/fail). However, code-research §2 shows the existing SEND_MESSAGE/SEND_IMAGE/MENU branches also handle two additional exception types: BotTokenInvalidException → fail('invalid_bot_token') and AppException → fail(codeOrStatus(ex)). Neither is mentioned in Task 3 nor Decision 3 for the new MESSAGE branch. An implementer reading only the tech-spec may produce a branch that handles TelegramSendException but lets BotTokenInvalidException/AppException propagate uncaught.

summary: All 7 round-1 findings are confirmed resolved. Tech-spec now covers all 20 user-spec requirements with no gaps, no partial coverage, and no missing items. Two minor new findings were introduced by the restructure: (1) FunnelSummaryResponse.java is absent from Task 4's Files to modify list despite being mentioned in the description; (2) Task 3/Decision 3 cover TelegramSendException semantics but do not mention the BotTokenInvalidException + AppException catch arms present in the existing branches being deleted. Both are minor — no critical findings remain. Verdict: pass.
